svg.text: The Canon after the Consecration · LM-104A–LM-112D · spoken 1962 Low Mass, two servers

g.text: The servers return to the lowest step
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
AC1: genuflecting · plano-centre-epistle · faces altar · eyes altar · L at-side / R holding-bell

UNRESOLVED: The approved record does not fix the moment at which AC1 sets the bell down at his
place on the lowest step as he returns.

VARIANT [profile-parameter] Where a named saint requires it, the priest inclines his head toward
the Missal on the Gospel side as the name is said. This is conditional on the name occurring,
not a fixed gesture of the scene, and it is never drawn as part of the baseline panel.

VARIANT [local-custom] Some local customs have AC1 ring the bell once at the minor elevation. It
is a local custom only. The canonical spoken Low Mass profile has no bell here, and INV-BELL-03
rejects a bell at the minor elevation being treated as the baseline.
UNRESOLVED: The approved record does not fix where the pall rests while the chalice is
